dossier.title: Krait Bounty
briefing: I am {PATRON} at {HERE}. A Krait has been taking ships on the lane. The station will not tolerate it.
I will pay a bounty for its destruction. Go to the location we name. Hunt the Krait and destroy it. If it jumps, no bounty.

hunt.arrive: Destroy the Krait near {TARGET} for bounty {PAY}.

dossier.lead: {PATRON} has posted a bounty for a Krait at {WORLD}.

rumour.far: Bounty posted: a Krait has been hitting traffic near {WORLD}, and {PATRON} wants it dead.
rumour.near: {PATRON} at {WORLD} offers credits for the destruction of a Krait hunting that space.

dossier.news: {PATRON} at {WORLD} posts a bounty for the destruction of a Krait threatening the lane.
